title: ForgeAccountUpdatedPayload

forgeAccountId.description: A forge account's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

slug.description: The new slug, when it changed.

aliases.description: The aliases now, when they changed.

origin.description: A forge origin: https, or http for a LAN or tailnet instance, then the host in lower case and a port only when it is not the scheme's default (https://git.example.com:5526); no userinfo, path or trailing slash.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

verifiedAt.description: When the credential last answered as the forge account's identity on this origin; null while unverified, when it is not served.

items.description: A second origin the same forge instance answers on, and when the forge account's identity was last verified there.

credential.description: The new credential source, when the credential was replaced.

login.description: The account gh reads the token for on the forge account's host, as gh names it.

oneOf.description: The environment's own gh, signed in for the forge account's host and this login, read on every operation so it follows gh's rotations.

provenance.description: pasted (a person pasted it), imported (the state import carried it over) or oauth (a device flow, milestone 3).

entry.description: The environment's vault entry holding a stored token, one per credential it was given: forge:<forge account id>:<entry id>. Never the token itself.

oneOf.description: A token the environment holds in its vault, never answered again: where it came from, and the vault entry that holds it.

entry.description: The environment's vault entry holding a stored token, one per credential it was given: forge:<forge account id>:<entry id>. Never the token itself.

clientSessionId.description: A client session's id, as hello names it and the access methods list and revoke it.

label.description: The client session's label when it handed the token over.

handedOverBy.description: The client session that handed its own gh's token over, by id and label.

followsGhRotations.description: Always false: the token is a copy of what the client's gh held when it was handed over, and gh's later rotations never reach it.

oneOf.description: A token a client's own gh handed over once, held in the vault: the client session that handed it over, and that it does not follow gh's rotations.
A token the environment holds in its vault, by where it came from.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference is read through.

mount.description: The KV mount, as personal or secret/team: no slash at either end.

path.description: The secret's path under the mount, as harness/forge-github.

key.description: The key inside the secret whose value is read.

oneOf.description: A value in OpenBao or Vault: a key of the secret at a path under a KV mount.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference is read through.

name.description: The secret's name: upper-case letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.

project.description: The project, when the connection's token does not fix one.

config.description: The config, when the connection's token does not fix one.

oneOf.description: A Doppler secret by name, with its project and config when the token does not fix them.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference is read through.

vault.description: The vault, by name or id.

item.description: The item, by name or id.

field.description: The field whose value is read.

oneOf.description: A 1Password field, as an op:// reference names it: vault, item and field.

connectionId.description: The key-manager connection the reference is read through.

secretId.description: The secret's id, which is what is read.

key.description: The secret's key, for display only.

oneOf.description: A Bitwarden Secrets Manager secret by id, with its key for display.

reference.description: Where a credential sits in a key manager, never its value: the provider, the connection it is read through, and the provider's locator (OpenBao mount, path and key; a Doppler name with its project and config; a 1Password vault, item and field; a Bitwarden secret id with its key).

oneOf.description: A key-manager reference, resolved on every operation and never cached, so a rotation in the key manager is live at once.
No credential: a copy from another environment awaiting one here.

identity.description: Who a new credential answered as, when it answered: the same user id, its login as it is now.

login.description: The login the forge's user endpoint answered, which may change while the user id stays.

userId.description: The forge's numeric user id as decimal digits, a string so that no JSON reader rounds it: what makes a credential the same identity.

problem.description: The problem after a new credential, when the credential was replaced: null when it answered.

kind.description: What is wrong with a forge account: needs-credential (a copy with none), credential-rejected (401 on its identity), credential-unavailable (the key manager or gh signed out, or the vault entry missing), identity-changed (another user id answered; unused until the credential is replaced), unreachable (the forge did not answer) or expiring (the token expires within thirty days).

since.description: Since when the forge account has had this problem.

message.description: One plain line for people: what is wrong and what to do. It holds no HTTP status, user id or exact time: those are in details.

details.description: The raw facts behind the line; absent when there are none, and on a problem recorded before details were.

anyOf.description: A forge account's problem: which, since when, one plain line saying what to do, and the raw facts behind it.

description: forge.account.updated: a forge account's slug, aliases or credential changed; each field present only when it did.
